earnings_definition.description: Applicable to groups quoting Long-Term or Short-Term Disability.

employees_related.description: Applicable to groups of 2-3 employees. A value of 'true' indicates that the employees are related by blood or by marriage. Relation by blood or marriage includes spouses, parents, children, siblings, aunts/uncles, nieces/nephews, cousins and in-laws.

has_hartford_disability.description: Applicable to groups quoting Long-Term or Short-Term Disability. A value of 'true' indicates that this group already has active Disability policies through The Hartford.

involves_cannabis.description: Applicable to all groups. A value of 'true' indicates that this group is involved in the operations, dispensing, or growing of cannabis.

makes_firearms_or_asbestos.description: Applicable to all groups. A value of 'true' indicates that this group is involved in the manufacturing of firearms, or handling or manufacturing of asbestos.
